column1: 5.5.4.5.12.2 Remove ES Auto BITE Reference Data. User shall click on a row in the
table and click on ‘Remove’. User shall repeat this procedure to remove others rows;
alternately, user can click on ‘Delete All’ option to delete all the entries in the table. It is not
suggested to remove a single row; if at all to remove, remove all the rows in the table and
add new ES auto BITE reference data for all the receivers, afresh.
5.5.4.5.12.3 Add ES Auto BITE Reference Data. User can add ES auto BITE
reference data if no previous data exists or if there is a change in Auto BITE configuration.
